title: Hamilton-Type Gradient Estimates for Porous Medium and Fast Diffusion Equations on Riemannian Manifolds for all exponents
summary: We establish local Hamilton-type gradient estimates for positive $C^{2,1}$ solutions of $u_t=Δu^m$ on complete Riemannian manifolds whose Ricci curvature is bounded from below. For every fixed $m>1$ and every fixed $0 0$ and $C=C(m,n)>0$ such that a solution $0<u\leqslant A$ in $B_{2R}(x_0)\times(t_0-T,t_0]$ satisfies the following local gradient estimate \begin{equation*} \sup_{B_R(x_0)\times(t_0-T/2,t_0]}|\nabla u^β| \leqslant C A^β\left(\frac1R+\sqrt{k}+\frac{A^{(1-m)/2}}{\sqrt T}\right), \end{equation*} where $\mathrm{Ric}_M\geqslant-k$.
